start.text: (He finishes a three-chord song with more joy than accuracy.) Three chords and the truth, boss. That's all anyone on this street ever played.

tipped.text: Ah, patron of the arts! Here - (he shows you a shape) - ring finger, middle finger, little one. G. Everyone's first chord. Your fingers will remember it tonight.

listen.text: Listening is free. Clapping is also free. (He starts the same song again.)

again.text: G, then C, then D, then back home to G. That's the whole secret. Don't tell the shop.
